chunks: From him, from Mansur ibn al-Abbas, from Muhammad ibn Abdullah ibn Wasi', from Ishaq ibn Ismail, from Muhammad ibn Yazeed, from Abu Dawud al-Nakha'i, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) said: 'Anoint yourselves with oil and use it as a condiment, for it is the anointing of the best and the condiment of the chosen ones. It was wiped with the Holy [spirit/essence] twice, blessed coming and blessed going, no illness harms with it.'

key_terms.أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Commander of the Faithful (Ali ibn Abi Talib)
key_terms.الزَّيْت: Oil (specifically olive oil in this context)

ai.seo_question: What are the spiritual and health benefits of olive oil according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) narrates that Amir al-Mu'minin Ali ibn Abi Talib (peace be upon him) recommended using olive oil both for external anointing and as a food condiment. The text highlights its spiritual and physical purity, describing it as blessed in both directions and protective against illness. This tradition is foundational in Shia medical jurisprudence, linking the physical benefits of olive oil to its spiritual status as 'the oil of the elect,' often interpreted in light of the Light Verse.

en.hubeali:
From him, from Mansour Bin Al Abbas, from Muhammad Bin Abdullah Bin Wasi’a, from Is’haq Bin Ismail, from Muhammad Bin Yazeed, from Abu Dawood Al Nkhai’e, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Massage with the oil, and use it as a sauce for it is a massager of the best ones and a sauce of the Chosen ones. It has been wiped with the Holiness twice, Blessed coming and Blessed returning, an illness does not harm with it’.
en.sarwar: 4. It is narrated from the narrator of the previous Hadith from Mansur ibn al-‘Abbas from Muhammad ibn ‘Abd Allah ibn Wasi’ from Ishaq ibn ’Isma‘il from Muhammad ibn Yazid from abu Dawud al-Nakha’iy who has said the following: “

’Amir al-Mu’minin, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘Use olives for rubbing and as sauce; it is the rubbing oil of the virtuous people and the sauce of the chosen ones. It was touched with holiness twice and it was blessed when coming and returning (plentiful or scarce) and with it illness does not harm.”’
